data.one_liner: Shows native alert and confirm dialogs on iOS, Android, Web, and macOS.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple API to display platform‑native alert and confirmation dialogs. The dialogs use the OS UI on each platform and support basic actions and optional cancellation. It works on mobile, web and macOS with minimal configuration.
use_when: You need a quick native‑look dialog without custom UI design
Cross‑platform apps that require simple alerts or confirmations
You want a lightweight solution without extra dependencies
avoid_when: You need more than three actions on Android
You require custom styling, theming, or complex layouts
You need full‑screen or modal dialog experiences
strengths: Uses true native UI on each platform
Works on Android, iOS, Web, and macOS
Very small API surface and easy to integrate
weaknesses: Android limited to three actions (default, cancel, destructive)
No support for complex dialog content
